facts.fact: CEGA and Togo's Ministry of Public Service Efficiency and Digital Transformation announced a new Data Ambassadors Program under the Togo Data Lab to train 27 data specialists in government, and expect to train 70 government data scientists in the first two years.
The Data Ambassadors Program will train 27 data specialists to strengthen data governance and analytical capacity in all of Togo's government ministries, per CEGA's announcement.
